This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be performed 
 every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block

Generator 
 air cooler function is to cool in closed loop circuit by exchange heat between the 
 generator air and water. Two coolers water/air are used for cooling the air of 
 the generator indirectly by water and the hot water return back to the cooler 
 to cool by forced air using fan.

This document 
 initiated by eng. Mostafa Ahmed Shaaban, tested by eng. Mohamed Al-Sayed Ahmed, and approved by eng. Mohamed Salah Eldin Abd 
 Elghafar: general director of Wadi Hof Power Station.

This document 
 revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: CEPC quality control director, and 
 certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's 
 Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.

If a 
 rather heavy soiling is to be expected, the heat exchanger should be designed 
 with removable collectors. The elimination of dirt deposits or product remnant 
 from the tubes or collectors is an easy task. According to the degree of 
 soiling, the tubes can be cleaned in different ways

For the inside cleaning, just as for the exterior, a cleaning appliance with a 
high pressure water jet can as well be used (required pressure: up to 500 atm.). 
Through a nozzle head at the end of a tube plain water is being pulverizes under 
very high pressure against the soiled inner side of the heat exchanger tube. The 
cleaning effect result from very sharp water jets, which breaks up the incrusted 
layer without damaging the tube.

The accumulated dirt deposits can be removed with a special brush. As to the 
material and hardness, these brushes are matched to the used heat exchanger 
tubes. Rinse the tubes thoroughly at the end of the cleaning.

Cleaning The Exterior (Air 
Side)
Normally it is possible to clean 
 the heat exchanger fins during operation. The cleaning method depends on the 
 degree of soiling. The exterior part of the heat exchanger is cleaned 
 mechanically or by hydraulic method.
Hydraulic method
إذا 
 اتساخ الزعانف ذو طبيعة أكثر مقاومة، ويمكن استخدام التنظيف باستخدام أ 
 يجب استخدام نفاثات المياه ذات الضغط العالي. إذا كان الأمر يتعلق بالزيتية أو السخامية 
 إيداع، يجب إضافة عامل التنظيف إلى الماء. احرص على عدم القيام بذلك 
 تشوه الشفرات عند تطبيق نفاث الماء.
Mechanical Method
If the 
 dirt deposit is of slight, dry or dusty nature, the HE fins can be cleaned by 
 means of a jet of compressed air.
If the 
 soiling and accumulated fibrous material is mainly around the fins inlet area, 
 it is to be eliminated with a soft brush.
If the 
 dirt deposit is of slight, dry or dusty nature, the HE fins can be cleaned by 
 means of a jet of compressed air.
If the 
 soiling and accumulated fibrous material is mainly around the fins inlet area, 
 it is to be eliminated with a soft brush.
Inside Cleaning (water side)
If a 
 rather heavy soiling is to be expected, the heat exchanger should be designed 
 with removable collectors. The elimination of dirt deposits or product remnant 
 from the tubes or collectors is an easy task. According to the degree of 
 soiling, the tubes can be cleaned in different ways
Hydraulic Cleaning
For the inside cleaning, just as for the exterior, a cleaning appliance with a 
high pressure water jet can as well be used (required pressure: up to 500 atm.). 
Through a nozzle head at the end of a tube plain water is being pulverizes under 
very high pressure against the soiled inner side of the heat exchanger tube. The 
cleaning effect result from very sharp water jets, which breaks up the incrusted 
layer without damaging the tube.
Mechanical Cleaning
The accumulated dirt deposits can be removed with a special brush. As to the 
material and hardness, these brushes are matched to the used heat exchanger 
tubes. Rinse the tubes thoroughly at the end of the cleaning.
